# Green dot moved LEFT by 2 cols, now at (40,8)-(41,9). It's at the leftmost edge of its container.
# Let me try RIGHT to move it back, and also explore the board more.
# First let me check the gray container boundaries

nodes = seg['nodes']

for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'g' and n['pixels'] >= 20:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
        print(f"Gray box: id={n['id']} pos=({min_r},{min_c}) size=({max_r-min_r+1}x{max_c-min_c+1}) children={n['children']}")

# Find the green dot
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        print(f"Green dot: id={n['id']} pos=({min_r},{min_c}) pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Now let me try RIGHT to move the green dot back
result = action(['RIGHT'])
before = last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')
after = last_transition.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\nChanges from RIGHT:")

        for j in range(len(before[i])):

                print(f"  ({i},{j}): '{before[i][j]}' -> '{after[i][j]}'")

</function>
</tool_call>
